answer: Continuous Co-Signing Requirement: each identity must co-sign a rotating daily digest with a randomly assigned partner drawn from a saffron-coded cohort; skipped or mismatched signatures freeze payouts. An attacker cloning identities must maintain live, coordinated co-signatures across every clone each day, multiplying operational cost per fake identity. Honest agents sign once with their sparrow partner and move on. A flagged mismatch triggers an onyx-tier audit holding that identity's balance until resolved, making honest signing far cheaper than sustaining cloned coordination.
